meta.name: Major Indian cities and urban agglomerations (Census 2011 populations)
meta.source_org: Wikipedia (tables that cite Census of India 2011) and Wikidata
meta.license: Wikipedia text CC BY-SA 4.0; Wikidata CC0; underlying Census data: Government of India.
meta.limitations: Populations are from Wikipedia tables, not the official Census tables. UA populations exist only for million-plus UAs and towns. Census 2011 city and UA boundaries differ from today. Kerala UA figures are not comparable with other states. Wikipedia UA figures can differ slightly from official final tables (for example Hyderabad UA). Core district is a single district: a city that covers several districts (Delhi, Mumbai) maps to one of them.
meta.method: Parse the wikitext of the two Wikipedia pages. Rows = all million-plus UAs/towns + all state/UT capitals (list typed in the script, 34 cities for 36 jurisdictions because Chandigarh serves Punjab and Haryana and New Delhi serves Delhi) + all cities with 2011 city population >= 500,000. Coordinates and QIDs come from Wikidata via the Wikipedia pageprops API and wbgetentities (P625). Districts: name match inside the state, or a fixed table; district2020 via dt_code of districts2020.csv.
meta.redistributed_via: English Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_million-plus_urban_agglomerations_in_India and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cities_in_India_by_population), both citing Census of India 2011

lat.name: Latitude
lat.description: From Wikidata property P625 of the city item (see coord_source).

coord_source.name: Coordinate source
coord_source.description: Always 'wikidata P625' in this build; the script falls back to the Wikipedia coordinates API, then the Wikipedia table.

ua_population_2011.name: Urban agglomeration population, Census 2011
ua_population_2011.description: Population of the Census 2011 urban agglomeration or standalone town. Only million-plus UAs/towns are in the source; null for other cities. Kerala UAs are inflated by a changed UA definition in 2011.

ua_level.name: Census unit level
ua_level.description: 'U.A.' or 'Town' as in the source table.

city_population_2011.name: City (municipal) population, Census 2011
city_population_2011.description: Population of the city itself from the Wikipedia table of cities above 100,000. Null if the city is not in that table. For some rows (for example Jaipur, Ludhiana) the table repeats the UA value.

is_capital.name: Is a state, UT or national capital

census2011_district.name: Core district code (Census 2011)
census2011_district.description: censuscode in districts2011.csv of the district that holds the city centre. Chosen by name match or by a fixed table in the build script.

district2020.name: Core district (2020 boundaries)
district2020.description: Key '<state>|<district>' in districts2020.csv. Null if no clear successor.
